design.style: Modern dark minimalist with punchy energetic neon accents, card-based layouts, and bold progress rings
design.typography: Modern geometric sans with bold numeric streak counters

screens.name: Today Dashboard
screens.purpose: The primary daily view where users see their overall completion progress and check off habits by time of day.
keyElements: Date picker carousel with week overview and completion rings
Overall daily progress ring ('5 of 7 completed')
Time-of-day categorized habit cards with interactive streak toggle buttons
Active streak fire indicator and motivational prompt
Floating action button to quickly add a new habit

screens.name: Habit Detail & History
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a single habit's historical performance, active streak records, and reminder preferences.
keyElements: Habit name, icon, category tag, and current streak counter
Key stats: best streak, total completions, and current consistency percentage
Reminder time settings and quick pause/edit controls

screens.name: Create & Edit Habit
screens.purpose: Configure a new habit with custom icons, frequencies, target times, and notification reminders.
keyElements: Habit name input with quick suggested presets (e.g. Read 20m, Drink Water, Meditate)
Frequency selector (Daily, Specific Days, X times per week)
Time-of-day grouping and reminder time picker

screens.name: Settings & Reminders
screens.purpose: Manage global notification schedules, sound effects, data backup, and app preferences.
keyElements: Global daily morning briefing and evening recap reminder toggles
Haptic feedback and celebration sound switches

plan.summary: A frictionless habit tracker that builds momentum through satisfying streaks, focused habit history, and timely smart reminders.
plan.navigation: A clean 2-tab bottom navigation (Today and Settings) with modal stacks for Habit Creation and Habit Detail history.
plan.targetUsers: Individuals looking to build consistent routines, break bad habits, and stay accountable to their daily goals.
coreFeatures: One-tap daily habit completion with haptic streak counters
Time-of-day habit grouping (Morning, Afternoon, Evening, Anytime)
Per-habit streak heatmaps, completion rates, and milestone stats
Customizable push reminders with targeted schedules
Streak freeze protection and flexible weekly frequency goals
